CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  DEVELOPMENT SERVICES DEPARTMENT
  PLANNING DIVISION
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING AGENDA
July 1, 2026, 7:00 P.M.
City Council Chambers – Ninth Floor
1 West Manchester Boulevard

1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll Call.

3.  Communications from staff.

  RULES OF DECORUM - Click Here to View

4.  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items. Persons wishing to address
  the Planning Commission on any item on the agenda other than a
  public hearing may do so at this time.

5.  Minutes approval for June 3, 2026, Planning Commission meeting.

6.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A public hearing to consider an application by Brett Engstrom,
  representing Coco Ichibanya, for Special Use Permit No. 26-00009
  (SUP26-00009) to allow the on-site sale of beer and wine for a
  proposed approximately 2,200 square-foot restaurant that is part
  of the Hollywood Park Tomorrow retail center HPSP (Hollywood
  Park Specific Plan) zoned property at 1249 South District Drive.

  A Notice of Exemption (EA-CE-2026-067) has been prepared stating
  that the proposed project is categorically exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act, a copy of which is
  available for public review in the Planning Division office of
  City  Hall  and  via  email  request  to  al-
  martell@cityofinglewood.org.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to;
  1) Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2026-067;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving SUP26-00009.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS it is
  recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions as
  appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or any
  part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6a Documents

  b. A public hearing to consider an application by Sarkis Karadjian,
  for Special Use Permit No. 26-00010 (SUP26-00010) to allow a
  service station on an approximately 10,700 square-foot C-2A
  (Airport Commercial) zoned property at 4799 West Century
  Boulevard.

  A Notice of Exemption (EA-CE-2026-065) has been prepared stating
  that the proposed project is categorically exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act, a copy of which is
  available for public review in the Planning Division office of
  City  Hall  and  via  email  request  to
  bespinoza@cityofinglewood.org.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to;
  a. Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2026-067;
   b. Adopt the resolution approving SUP26-00009.
B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS it is
  recommended to:
  a. Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions as
  appropriate.
C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or any
  part thereof, it is recommended to:
  a. Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6b Documents

c. A public hearing to consider an application by Three6ixty, for
  Special Use Permit No. 26-00011 (SUP26-00011) to allow an
  electric vehicle charging service station on an MU-2A (Mixed
  Use-2A) zoned property at 8515 South La Cienega Boulevard.

  Notice of Exemptions (EA-CE-2026-068) has been prepared stating
  that the proposed project is categorically exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act, a copy of which is
  available for public review in the Planning Division office of
  City  Hall  and  via  email  request  to
  faith.smith@cityofinglewood.org.

Preliminary Recommendations:
A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2026-068;
  2) Adopt the attached resolution approving SUP26-00011.
B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it is
  recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or any
  part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6c Documents

d. A public hearing to consider an application by Alvin Santos,
  representing Dulan’s Soul Food restaurant for Special Use Permit
  No. 26-00013 (SUP26-00013) to allow outdoor dining and an event
  center in an existing one-story approximately 3,300 square-foot
  commercial building on an H-C (Historic Core) zoned property at
  202 East Manchester Boulevard.

  Notice of Exemptions (EA-CE-2026-064) has been prepared stating
  that the proposed project is categorically exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act, a copy of which is
  available for public review in the Planning Division office of
  City  Hall  and  via  email  request  to  al-
  martell@cityofinglewood.org.

Preliminary Recommendations:
A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2026-064;
  2) Adopt the attached resolution approving SUP26-00013.
B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it is
  recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or any
  part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6d Documents

e. A public hearing to consider an application by Dan Kassel,
  representing Googie Car Wash for Special Use Permit No. 26-00014
  (SUP26-00014) to allow an automated car wash facility on a C-2
  (General Commercial) zoned property at 6818 South La Cienega
  Boulevard.

  Notice of Exemptions (EA-CE-2026-069) has been prepared stating
  that the proposed project is categorically exempt from the
   California Environmental Quality Act, a copy of which is
  available for public review in the Planning Division office of
  City  Hall  and  via  email  request  to
  faith.smith@cityofinglewood.org.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2026-063;
  2) Adopt the attached resolution approving DR26-00024.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it is
  recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or any
  part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6e Documents

7.  Public Comments. Anyone wishing to address the Planning Commission
  on any matter within their jurisdiction and not elsewhere
  considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

8.  Commission Initiatives.

9.  Adjournment.

If you will require special accommodations due to a disability, please
contact the Planning Division at (310) 412-5230, One Manchester
Boulevard, Fourth Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301. All
requests for special accommodations must be received 48 hours prior to
the day of the hearing(s).

"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información, favor de
llamar a este número (310) 412-5230."

In the event that the Planning Commission meeting of July 1, 2026, is
not held, or is concluded prior to a public hearing or other agenda item
being considered, the public hearing or non-public hearing agenda item
will automatically be continued to the next regular Planning Commission
meeting.

  NEXT PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING:
